title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issues of When a Higher People's Court Shall Rule to Suspend Enforcement of a Legally Effective Judgment or Ruling of a Lower People's Court in the Procedure of Trial Supervision and Who Shall Sign the Ruling on Suspension of Enforcement

articles.content_en: 1. The higher People's Court may only rule to suspend enforcement of a legally effective judgment or ruling of a lower People's Court if it finds that there is indeed an error and has made a decision to bring the case up for trial or to order a retrial. Therefore, where a higher People's Court, during the process of reviewing the case files, has not yet found that there is indeed an error in a legally effective judgment or ruling of a lower People's Court and has not made a decision to bring the case up for trial or to order a retrial, it shall not rule to suspend enforcement.

2. Where a higher People's Court finds that there is indeed an error in a legally effective judgment or ruling of a lower People's Court, it may make a ruling to bring the case up for trial or to order the lower People's Court to conduct a retrial. Such ruling shall include the content of suspending enforcement, shall be signed by the president of the court, and shall be affixed with the seal of the People's Court.
